description: This file contains implementation of graph transformation passes for handling control flow exits in TorchScript JIT compiler, including exit node unification, conditional execution, and control flow restructuring.

classes.name: ExitPair
classes.description: Represents a pair of a boolean exit indicator and associated exit values, used for control flow analysis.

classes.name: ExitTransformer
classes.description: Performs transformation of exit nodes in a graph, handling control flow exits like return, break, continue, and throw, and restructuring the graph accordingly.

methods.name: transformReturnStmts
methods.description: Transforms return statements in the graph to control flow exits.

methods.name: transformLoopContinuations
methods.description: Transforms loop continuation nodes in the graph to control flow exits.

methods.name: getExitStatus
methods.description: Determines the exit status (WILL, MIGHT, WONT, THROWS) from an ExitPair.

methods.name: transformExits
methods.description: Recursively transforms a block's nodes to handle control flow exits.

methods.name: transformIf
methods.description: Transforms an if node to handle control flow exits in its branches.

methods.name: transformWith
methods.description: Transforms a with node to handle control flow exits within its block.

methods.name: guardBlockNodes
methods.description: Wraps remaining nodes in a block with a conditional based on exit status.

methods.name: destroyNodeAfterExit
methods.description: Replaces node outputs with uninitialized values and destroys the node.

methods.name: deleteAfterExitNodes
methods.description: Deletes nodes after an exit point within a block.

methods.name: updateTargetBlock
methods.description: Updates the target block for control flow based on node kind.

methods.name: matchValuesWithUnitialized
methods.description: Creates a vector of uninitialized values matching given values' types.

methods.name: getUnitValue
methods.description: Returns a cached or newly created uninitialized value of a given type.
